evs.name: Proof of Purchase / Official Offer
evs.description: Official offer or proof of purchase of the electric vehicle from the dealer.

evs.name: Solemn Declaration (Law 1599/1986)
evs.description: Declaration by the beneficiary that the same vehicle is not subsidized by another financial program.

evs.name: Proof of Identity
evs.description: Copy of ID Card or Passport (Not required if identification is done via TAXISnet).

evs.name: Income Tax Clearance Certificate
evs.description: Copy of the Income Tax Clearance Certificate for the last tax year.

evs.name: Company Legal Documents
evs.description: Valid representation certificate from GEMI, E3 form of the last tax year, and AADE business commencement certificate.

evs.name: Vehicle Scrapping Documents
evs.description: Vehicle registration certificate of the vehicle to be scrapped and proof of payment of circulation taxes.

evs.name: KEPA Medical Certificate
evs.description: Valid Disability Certification medical opinion from KEPA, certifying the condition.

evs.name: Large/Three-Child Family Certificate
evs.description: Recent Certificate of Family Status and ASPE Certificate.

evs.name: Smart Charger Documents
evs.description: CE certificate of the charger and Solemn Declaration of the Electrician Installer.

evs.name: Certificate of Permanent Residence
evs.description: Certificate of Permanent Residence from the Island Municipality (issued via gov.gr).

evs.name: Leasing Agreement
evs.description: Copy of the leasing agreement (at least 36 months) with a clear clause for the purchase of the vehicle at the end of it.

evs.name: Second Battery Documents
evs.description: Proof of purchase for the additional battery and CE technical characteristics certificate.

criterion_requirements.name: The purchase or lease must be for a purely electric vehicle (not a hybrid).
